metadata.title: Provenance-coherence gating and selective prediction risk
metadata.research_question: Does requiring scenario-coherent or source-row-coherent typed paths improve accepted-proposal reliability, and what coverage is sacrificed?
metadata.split_protocol: Same deterministic scenario-level split procedure as E1; all records from a scenario remain in one partition.
metadata.proposal_source: GraphReasoner selected typed paths; no LLM proposals.

policy_definitions.same_scenario: Require every edge to have scenario/source/evidence provenance and require all edges to originate in one scenario.
policy_definitions.same_source_row: Require every edge to be grounded and all edge source IDs to resolve to one source row.

metadata.provenance_interpretation: Scenario/row coherence measures documentary consistency of the reconstructed records. It is not calibrated confidence, statistical independence, expert validation, or physical causality.
metadata.unsupported_definition: A proposal is unsupported when its selected path is absent, or any path edge lacks a scenario ID, parseable source-row ID, or non-empty evidence text.
metadata.coverage_definition: Fraction of test queries with at least one accepted proposal.
metadata.gold_label_semantics: Reconstructed worksheet row co-associations; not independently expert-validated physical causal ground truth.

ungated.policy_semantics: Accept every GraphReasoner proposal with a selected path.

same_scenario.policy_semantics: Accept only when every path edge is grounded and all edges originate from one scenario.

same_source_row.policy_semantics: Accept only when every path edge is grounded and all edge source IDs identify the same dataset/scenario/row.
